gameDescriptionHtml:
The legendary beat ’em up series from Jaleco returns. Master trained fighters take on a rising evil with raw strength and refined technique. Built around easy-to-use auto-combos, the game lets skilled players weave powerful strings for exhilarating combat. Let your fists burn with fury once more.

Neo-Cisco has been shaken by the Joecal crime syndicate and the deadly Zeekus virus. But each time, justice has prevailed thanks to a small band of brave fighters. Now, they must rise up again to face an overwhelming evil and discover the true mastermind behind these past events. New moves, new weapons, and new allies mix in this ultimate Beat ’em up, Rushing Beat. Restore peace to the streets in the hot 2-player co-op story mode that doubles the impact!

Game Features

  • ACTION – With easy-to-use auto-combos, even beginners can enjoy exhilarating action. Chain together your own combos with various actions like counterattacks, follow-up strikes, and weapon-based attacks. Most actions can be canceled with dashes or jumps. Master the cancel system and unleash even more consecutive attacks! Throw techniques can be varied with key inputs. Send your targeted enemies flying, and if you throw them into the background, you can destroy normally unreachable objects. A chance to get items! As you land hits or take damage, your rage gauge increases. When the gauge reaches MAX, you enter rage mode. In addition to enhanced attack and defense, you can unleash the finishing move “Beat Rush”. Defeat evil with righteous fury!
  • CHAPTER – There are 9 stages in total. Defeat enemies waiting in various areas such as shopping malls, slums, subways, and laboratories, and chase the truth of the story. Side missions also occur in each scene. Challenge the capture of various actions and stage gimmicks!
  • CHARACTER – Playable characters increase as the story progresses, bringing the team to a total of 6 members. Master the unique actions different for each fighter. Also, this title supports 2-player co-op. Advance with your allies on the path to The Peace Keepers!
  • FOOD – If you board the kitchen car Tough enough, which is also a checkpoint of the stage, you can combine the food items you have. A combo menu made with 3 types of food increases the recovery amount. Furthermore, special effects may be added. Whether attacking or eating, combos are recommended!
